claim: Progressive removal of question-critical evidence reduces VLM task performance.
evidence: Critical masking and blur severity curves.

claim: Native VLM confidence responds to evidence loss in aggregate but is frequently non-monotonic within individual evidence trajectories.
Question-critical masking causes substantially larger degradation than matched non-critical masking.
Evidence-order regularization reduces evidence-order violations compared with BCE-only training.
The evidence-order benefit transfers from masking to an unseen local blur degradation.
The method improves selective prediction over native confidence.
The method significantly improves AUROC over BCE-only.
